old_caption: The video captures a serene winter scene at a ski resort. The camera is stationary, positioned near a chairlift, providing a fixed perspective of the snowy landscape. The sun shines brightly in the sky, casting a warm glow over the snow-covered mountains and ski slopes below. A skier can be seen gliding down the slope in the foreground, their figure small against the vast expanse of white. The lift poles stand tall, with chairs suspended from cables, moving past the camera. The overall atmosphere is one of tranquility and excitement, as people enjoy the beautiful winter weather and the thrill of skiing.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a serene winter scene at a ski resort. The camera is positioned on a chairlift, providing a dynamic perspective as it moves upward through the snowy landscape. The sun shines brightly in the sky, casting a warm glow over the snow-covered mountains and ski slopes below. Skiers and snowboarders can be seen gliding down the slopes, their figures small against the vast expanse of white. The camera pans slightly to the right, revealing more of the mountainous terrain and the ski lift system. The lift poles stand tall, with chairs suspended from cables, ready to transport the next group of adventurers up the mountain. The overall atmosphere is one of tranquility and excitement, as people enjoy the beautiful winter weather and the thrill of skiing.
caption: The video captures a sunlit alpine ski slope with a chairlift tower on the left, snow-covered peaks behind, and a bright low sun throwing a starburst and lens flare. A lone skier already in motion glides diagonally across the foreground from near the tower base toward the lower-right, growing slightly larger. This skier slips out of the bottom edge partway through, leaving the foreground clear. A second figure appears briefly at the bottom-right corner early on before leaving the frame. Meanwhile the chairlift chairs travel steadily along the cable, the right-hand chair drifting toward the sun while the left-hand chairs also advance along the line. The camera gradually tightens on the tower and backdrop, raising the crossbar and enlarging the orange base pad and chairs, so the marker pole with its red flag and the mountains shift within the frame while remaining present.

draft_caption: The video captures a sunlit alpine ski slope with a chairlift tower on the left, snow-covered peaks behind, and a bright low sun throwing a starburst and lens flare. A lone skier already in motion glides diagonally across the foreground from near the tower base toward the lower-right, growing slightly larger. This skier slips out of the bottom edge partway through the excerpt, leaving the foreground clear. A second figure, glimpsed at the bottom-right corner early on, moves right and leaves almost immediately. Meanwhile the chairlift chairs travel steadily along the cable, the right-hand chair drifting toward the sun while the left-hand chairs shift toward the upper-left. The camera gradually tightens on the tower and backdrop, raising the crossbar and enlarging the orange base pad and chairs. The marker pole with its red flag, the textured snow, and the mountains remain constant throughout.

review_issues.quote: moves right and leaves almost immediately
review_issues.problem: The second figure sits at the bottom-right corner in the first frames and simply exits; there is no clear rightward travel visible before it disappears.

review_issues.quote: the left-hand chairs shift toward the upper-left
review_issues.problem: Across the frames the left-side chairs do not show a consistent upper-left translation relative to the tower; the direction is not supported, so it should be stated only as advancing along the cable.

Because the camera tightens, the marker pole and the mountains move within the frame (the pole drifts toward the lower-right and grows), so they are not constant in position; they only remain present.
